copy.heading: The putt on the 7th
body: The Programme is aware of the putt on the 7th. It was a six-foot putt, slightly downhill, with a left-to-right break that you read correctly. It was struck well. It lipped out. The Programme accepts that this was unlucky.
The Programme also notes that the putt was struck in May 2019.

Since then it has been described at two Christmases, one wedding, a hospital visiting hour, a christening and a parents' evening that you attended in place of Sue and at which you were not asked about golf. During this stage you are asked to stop telling the story of the putt. If you feel the story coming on, you may use the cut-out card below.
